items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wasn't there somebody named Streamline Harris? [INTERVIEWEE] Streamline Isaac Harris Isidore. All of those are his name.

ctx.x: He'd be around us today, right today. Maybe sometime I'd get him together and he'll, you know, give you an interview. I thought-
Wasn't there somebody named Streamline Harris?
Streamline Isaac Harris Isidore. All of those are his name. Isidore Isaac Harris. His full name was Streamline Isaac Harris.
